# Kryneth Gateway

> Kryneth is the open-source execution-integrity layer and agent runtime control plane for AI systems that can take consequential actions against real-world systems.

Kryneth provides a neutral, deterministic execution boundary between AI-generated intent and external side effects (financial transactions, cloud infrastructure mutations, database writes, CRM/ERP updates, communications, and Model Context Protocol tool invocations). Built in Rust on Axum and Tokio, it enforces execution identity, deterministic SHA-256 idempotency, monotonic lease versioning, stale completion fencing, and explicit `UNKNOWN` outcome state handling—preventing unsafe side-effect replay when networks time out or agents fail.

## Core Concepts & Invariants

- [Execution Boundary](ARCHITECTURE.md): The structural boundary where an AI-generated action becomes a physical side effect (`AI Agent -> Kryneth -> External System`).
- [Execution State Machine](src/domain/execution.rs): Explicit execution lifecycle states (`Pending`, `Claimed`, `Running`, `Succeeded`, `Failed`, `Unknown`, `Reconciling`).
- [Timeout != Failure Invariant](README.md#the-failure-scenario-timeout--failure): When an upstream network drops or times out after downstream dispatch, Kryneth marks the state as `UNKNOWN` rather than `Failed`, blocking blind retries (`PREVIOUS_ATTEMPT_UNKNOWN`) and triggering out-of-band reconciliation.
- [Deterministic Idempotency](src/infrastructure/mcp_client.rs): Deeply key-sorted canonical JSON SHA-256 hashing producing authoritative `IdempotencyKey` instances immune to JSON key-ordering variation.
- [Monotonic Lease Versioning & Stale Completion Fencing](src/usecases/execution_service.rs): Incremental `version: u64` tagging that fences out late-arriving detached background completions from overwriting newer execution state.
- [Agent Guardian](src/usecases/behavior_guard.rs): Ephemeral nonce-agnostic `ahash` parameter signature tracking detecting runaway agent loops and tool storms (default limit: 5 identical calls per session).
- [Two-Phase Lazy Schema Loading](src/usecases/tool_router.rs): Strips bulky MCP parameter JSON schemas down to 1-line semantic summaries on default turns, reducing per-tool token overhead by ~95% while serving full schemas on-demand via virtual phantom tool interception.
- [Memory-Bounded L1/L2 Semantic Caching](src/infrastructure/l1_cache.rs): Moka-based in-memory cache with explicit byte weighers enforcing strict heap limits (default: 100 KB semantic limit; >= 1000 tokens relegated to L2 to prevent RAM exhaustion).
- [ReDoS-Safe PII Firewall](src/usecases/proxy.rs): DFA-compatible, non-backtracking regular expressions scanning for Credit Cards, SSNs, Aadhaar, Emails, Phone Numbers, and IFSC codes.

## Repository Architecture & Code Organization

- [Clean Architecture / Ports & Adapters](ARCHITECTURE.md#ports--adapters-clean-architecture): Domain core decoupled from transport and storage via traits (`ToolTransport`, `ExecutionStore`, `Reconciler`, `AuthResolver`, `RateLimiter`).
- [Ingress API (`src/api/`)](src/api/routes.rs): Axum HTTP routes for OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/models`, health probes `/healthz`, and admin metrics `/metrics`.
- [Domain Core (`src/domain/`)](src/domain/models.rs): Strongly-typed domain models, execution identity hierarchy (`Tenant -> Session -> Workflow -> Execution -> Operation -> Attempt`), and port definitions.
- [Infrastructure Adapters (`src/infrastructure/`)](src/infrastructure/oss_adapters.rs): In-memory OSS implementations (`MokaExecutionStore`, `OssTelemetry`, `OssBilling`, `OssRateLimit`) and provider adapters (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, Cohere).
- [Use Cases (`src/usecases/`)](src/usecases/execution_service.rs): Application pipelines including `execution_service.rs` (idempotency & lease orchestration), `behavior_guard.rs` (loop & tool storm detection), `proxy.rs` (streaming failover stitching & telemetry), and `tool_router.rs` (semantic MCP schema optimizer).
- [Adversarial Verification Harnesses (`tests/`)](tests/agent_db_reliability_test.rs): Comprehensive end-to-end integration tests proving zero duplicate mutations under commit-then-timeout failures, high-concurrency thundering herds, and network flaps.

## Quick Start & Ingress Integration

### Docker Deployment
```bash
docker run -d -p 8080:8080 krynethhq/krynethgw:latest
```

### Route Agent Traffic via OpenAI SDK
```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="http://localhost:8080/v1",
    api_key="your-api-key"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Process refund for order #1234"}],
    extra_headers={
        "x-kryneth-tenant-id": "tenant-prod-01",
        "x-kryneth-idempotency-key": "idem-refund-1234"
    }
)
```

### Direct HTTP Request
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer test-key" \
  -H "x-kryneth-tenant-id: acme-corp" \
  -H "x-kryneth-idempotency-key: charge-tx-9921" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-4o",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Execute database migration"}]
  }'
```
